errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar for 3/1/2024 as the lowest. The lowest visible bars are on 3/3/2024 and 3/14/2024. Furthermore, several dates have no bars, indicating zero precipitation, which would be the lowest value.

This value is incorrectly associated with the lowest bar. The value of the lowest visible bar is approximately 0.2 l/m², not 3.00 l/m². The value for the bar on 3/1/2024, which was misidentified as the lowest, is approximately 3.2 l/m².

The description fails to mention that for several dates (3/4/2024, 3/5/2024, 3/8/2024, 3/9/2024, 3/10/2024, and 3/15/2024) there are no bars, indicating zero precipitation. This is a significant aspect of the data presented.
The phrase 'забележимо покачване' (noticeable increase) is subjective and constitutes an interpretation rather than a direct, factual description of the chart's data.
